craft_notes: Sthāyin: cakrodaya unit 8. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In seven three-thousands but six-eighty-excess remembered; by hundreds but by twenty-seven in eight-syllable variation.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saptake trisahasraṃ tu ṣaḍaśītyadhikaṃ smṛtam śataistu saptaviṃśatyā varṇāṣṭakavikalpite
